**Universities that were in the THE World University Rankings top‑10 every year from 2020 to 2022 and whose “International Outlook” score in the 2018 rankings was below 75**

| University | 2018 International Outlook score |
|------------|----------------------------------|
| University of Oxford | 63.7 |
| University of Cambridge | 51.5 |
| California Institute of Technology | 59.7 |
| Stanford University | 60.5 |
| University of Chicago | 69.6 |
| Yale University | 69.6 |

These six institutions satisfy both conditions:

1. **Top‑10 in 2020, 2021, and 2022** – as shown in the official THE World University Rankings tables for each year.  
2. **International Outlook score under 75 in 2018** – according to the 2018 rankings, all listed scores are below the 75 threshold.  

(Universities such as MIT, Princeton, Harvard, etc., had International Outlook scores above 75 in 2018 and therefore do not meet the second condition.)
